ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "X-CORRELATION-ID": attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default correlationId, "name": attributes.headers.name, "systemId": attributes.headers.systemId, "source": attributes.headers.source }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "documentNumber": payload.documentNumber, "documentType": payload.documentType as String, "firstLastName": payload.firstLastName, "dateOfIssuance": payload.dateExpedition }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { nombres: vars.initialPayload.names, apellido: vars.initialPayload.firstLastName, segundo_apellido: vars.initialPayload.secondLastName, fecha_exp: vars.initialPayload.dateExpedition, num_doc: vars.initialPayload.documentNumber, tipo_doc: vars.initialPayload.documentType, fecha_consulta: now() as Date, estado: "NO VIGENTE", causal: vars.rsLisim.cause default vars.rsLisim.message default "" }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "fecha_consulta": "", "fecha_confronta": "", estado: "NO VIGENTE", causal: vars.rsLisim.cause default vars.rsLisim.message default "", "score_fija": {}, "score_movil": {}, }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "documentType": vars.initialPayload.documentType as String, "documentNumber": vars.initialPayload.documentNumber }

os:store.doc:name: store validation values
os:store.os:value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { identityId: vars.rsLisim.id, documentNumber: vars.initialPayload.documentNumber, documentType: vars.initialPayload.documentType, technology: vars.initialPayload.model.technology, segment: vars.initialPayload.model.segment }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "200", message: vars.rsLisim.cause default vars.rsLisim.message default "validacion exitosa", result: { "id": vars.rsLisim.id default "", "type": vars.rsLisim."type" default "", "questions": vars.rsLisim.questions default "", "otpCode": vars.rsLisim.otpCode default "", "matchType": vars.rsLisim.matchType default "" } }
